scope: The deterministic MANDATE gate: schema, grounding, persistence and the ratification binding. The live model proposal is a separate owner command and is not asserted here.
schema: The closed Mandate schema rejects a predicate outside the five-member vocabulary, params belonging to another predicate, an action outside PROCEED/REASK/HALT, more than five conditions, a numeric amount, and an invented `reserved` field (extra=forbid) -- tests/unit/test_mandate_schema.py, 11 tests.
grounding: GeminiAI._meaning refuses a cap above the one the buyer stated and refuses a lower cap the message never states; unstated expiries and undated conditions are dropped -- tests/unit/test_mandate_grounding.py, 10 tests.
persistence_and_binding: The delegation mint path validates conditions first, then recomputes the canonical mandate hash (category, conditions in order, expires_at UTC with milliseconds, max_cap_cents, sorted pool_ids; compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys) and refuses unless the stored 64-hex ratification_sha256 matches. A hash without mandate_version is verified too; a hash above the stated cap fails with 422; conditions without a hash are dropped as the contract says. tests/integration/test_mandate_persistence.py (7) and tests/unit/test_mandate_conditions.py (12) -- 19 passed; red-green proven by disabling the gate (4 tests failed, including a raised-cap POST returning 201 instead of 422).
token_narrowness: Because the hash covers the cap, scope, expiry and condition set, a token cannot carry values the buyer did not ratify. The per-entry cap remains enforced by agentapi/service.py; the mandate never authorizes a payment.
frontend: The Agent settings card hashes the canonical fields in the browser (sorted keys, compact JSON, toISOString expiry), renders the same fields as text, requires explicit ratification and resets it on any change; frontend/tests/settings.pages.test.tsx -- 17 passed.
not_included: A live-model run proving the model itself returns a schema-valid mandate (T09B06 acceptance bullet 1) is not asserted by this file. The owner command is `tools/live_gates.py mandate`; it runs after the free-tier daily quota resets and its JSON is added beside this file.
recorded_gap: Conditions are stored, validated and returned with the token, and their predicates resolve from stored rows only. No agent surface evaluates them yet, so a stop-and-ask condition is advisory rather than enforced; the cap and scope are enforced. This is recorded as open question Q-2026-11-08-39.
